name: claim_manager_queue_kpi
xsql:
SELECT FormatNumber(Nvl(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.status = 'Submitted' THEN 1 END), 0), '#,##0') AS awaiting_count,
       FormatNumber(Nvl(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.status = 'Approved'  THEN 1 END), 0), '#,##0') AS approved_count,
       FormatNumber(Nvl(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.status = 'Rejected'  THEN 1 END), 0), '#,##0') AS rejected_count,
       FormatNumber(Nvl(SUM(CASE WHEN c.status = 'Submitted' THEN c.claim_amount END), 0), '$#,###0.00') AS awaiting_value
FROM   claim.claim_request c
WHERE  c.employee_id IN ( SELECT pa.employee_id
                          FROM   xactly.xc_pos_hierarchy ph
                          INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos
                              ON pos.master_position_id = ph.to_pos_id
                          INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa
                              ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
                          INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa
                              ON  pa.participant_id = ppa.participant_id
                              AND pa.is_master      = 1
                          WHERE  ph.from_pos_id = :v_master_position_id
                            AND  ph.is_active   = 1 )
